Linear algebra primitives

Source: R/lax_linalg.R
lax_linalg.Rd

Ports of the functions of jax.lax.linalg. Every function works on batches of matrices (leading batch dimensions) unless noted, and none of them promotes dtypes. On CPU the decompositions run LAPACK through XLA custom calls; a failed decomposition returns arrays full of NaN for that batch element.

Usage

lax_linalg_cholesky(x, symmetrize_input = TRUE)

lax_linalg_cholesky_update(r_matrix, w_vector)

lax_linalg_eig(
  x,
  compute_left_eigenvectors = TRUE,
  compute_right_eigenvectors = TRUE,
  enable_eigvec_derivs = FALSE,
  implementation = NULL,
  use_magma = NULL
)

lax_linalg_eigh(
  x,
  lower = TRUE,
  symmetrize_input = TRUE,
  sort_eigenvalues = TRUE,
  subset_by_index = NULL,
  implementation = NULL
)

lax_linalg_hessenberg(a)

lax_linalg_householder_product(a, taus)

lax_linalg_lu(x)

lax_linalg_lu_pivots_to_permutation(pivots, permutation_size)

lax_linalg_ormqr(a, taus, c, left = TRUE, transpose = FALSE)

lax_linalg_qr(x, pivoting = FALSE, full_matrices = TRUE, use_magma = NULL)

lax_linalg_schur(
  x,
  compute_schur_vectors = TRUE,
  sort_eig_vals = FALSE,
  select_callable = NULL
)

lax_linalg_svd(
  x,
  full_matrices = TRUE,
  compute_uv = TRUE,
  subset_by_index = NULL,
  algorithm = NULL
)

lax_linalg_symmetric_product(
  a_matrix,
  c_matrix,
  alpha = 1,
  beta = 0,
  symmetrize_output = FALSE
)

lax_linalg_triangular_solve(
  a,
  b,
  left_side = FALSE,
  lower = FALSE,
  transpose_a = FALSE,
  conjugate_a = FALSE,
  unit_diagonal = FALSE
)

lax_linalg_tridiagonal(a, lower = TRUE)

lax_linalg_tridiagonal_solve(dl, d, du, b, perturb_singular = FALSE)

Arguments

x, a

Array with shape [..., m, n] (square where the operation requires it).

symmetrize_input

If TRUE, the matrix is symmetrized first by computing (x + x^H) / 2; otherwise only one triangle is used.

r_matrix

Upper triangular matrix R with A = R^T R.

w_vector

Vector of the rank one update.

compute_left_eigenvectors, compute_right_eigenvectors

Whether to compute the left and right eigenvectors.

enable_eigvec_derivs

Enable differentiation of the eigenvectors (valid only for distinct eigenvalues, under the LAPACK geev normalization).

implementation

Algorithm selection (see lax_linalg_EigImplementation and lax_linalg_EighImplementation); only LAPACK is available on CPU.

use_magma

Accepted for compatibility with JAX; only used on GPU.

lower

Which triangle of the matrix is used.

sort_eigenvalues

Sort the eigenvalues in ascending order (always the case on CPU).

subset_by_index

Optional pair c(start, end) of 0-based indices selecting a range of eigenvalues or singular values (not supported on CPU).

taus

Scalar factors of the elementary Householder reflectors, shape [..., k].

pivots

Integer (int32) array of row swaps with shape [..., k].

permutation_size

Size of the permutation (at least k).

c

Matrix to multiply by Q.

left

If TRUE compute Q C, else C Q.

transpose

If TRUE use Q^T (Q^H for complex types).

pivoting

Column pivoted (rank revealing) QR.

full_matrices

Whether full or reduced matrices are returned.

compute_schur_vectors

Whether to compute the Schur vectors Q.

sort_eig_vals, select_callable

Unused (as in JAX).

compute_uv

Whether to return the singular vectors.

algorithm

SVD algorithm (see lax_linalg_SvdAlgorithm); "default", "divide_and_conquer" (gesdd) and "QR" (gesvd) are available on CPU.

a_matrix, c_matrix

Matrices with shapes [..., m, n] and [..., m, m].

alpha, beta

Scalars.

symmetrize_output

If TRUE the upper triangle of the result is replaced by the transpose of the lower triangle.

b

Right hand side.

left_side

Solve op(A) X = B if TRUE, else X op(A) = B.

transpose_a, conjugate_a

Whether op transposes and conjugates a.

unit_diagonal

Assume a unit diagonal (the diagonal is not accessed).

dl, d, du

Lower, middle and upper diagonals, each with shape [..., m].

perturb_singular

Perturb near zero pivots so that singular systems return a finite result.

Value

An array, or a list of arrays as described above.

Details

  • lax_linalg_cholesky(): A = L L^H with L lower triangular.

  • lax_linalg_cholesky_update(): Cholesky factor of A + w w^T from the upper triangular factor R of A = R^T R (no batching).

  • lax_linalg_eig(): eigendecomposition of a general matrix; returns list(w, vl, vr) (eigenvectors only when requested).

  • lax_linalg_eigh(): eigendecomposition of a Hermitian matrix; returns list(v, w).

  • lax_linalg_hessenberg(): reduction to upper Hessenberg form; returns list(a, taus).

  • lax_linalg_householder_product(): product of elementary Householder reflectors.

  • lax_linalg_lu(): LU decomposition with partial pivoting, P A = L U; returns list(lu, pivots, permutation) with 0-based pivots and permutation.

  • lax_linalg_lu_pivots_to_permutation(): converts LU row swaps to a permutation.

  • lax_linalg_ormqr(): multiplies a matrix by the Q of a QR factorization without forming Q.

  • lax_linalg_qr(): QR decomposition; returns list(q, r) or list(q, r, p) with pivoting.

  • lax_linalg_schur(): Schur decomposition A = Q U Q^H; returns list(U, Q) or list(U).

  • lax_linalg_svd(): singular value decomposition; returns list(u, s, vh) or s.

  • lax_linalg_symmetric_product(): alpha A A^T + beta C.

  • lax_linalg_triangular_solve(): solves op(A) X = B (left_side) or X op(A) = B for triangular A.

  • lax_linalg_tridiagonal(): reduction of a Hermitian matrix to tridiagonal form; returns list(a, d, e, taus).

  • lax_linalg_tridiagonal_solve(): solves a tridiagonal system given the lower, middle and upper diagonals (dl[0] and du[m - 1] are ignored).
